title: GCL 并联谐振
statement: 正弦电流源 İ_s = 10∠0° mA（有效值）向 R = 1 kΩ、L = 10 mH、C = 1 µF 的并联电路供电，电源角频率等于电路的谐振角频率 ω₀。
求谐振频率 f₀、谐振时的端电压 V、电容电流 I_C，并判断 L、C 两条支路电流的相量和。

questions.ask: 谐振时端电压有效值 V = ?
questions.explain: 谐振时 Y = G + j(ωC − 1/ωL) = G，导纳最小、阻抗最大且等于 R：V = I_s·R = 10 mA × 1 kΩ = 10 V。

questions.ask: 谐振时 L、C 两条支路电流的相量和 İ_L + İ_C 的有效值 |İ_L + İ_C| 等于多少？
choices: 0（两者大小相等、相位相反，电源电流全部流过 R）
choiceExplain: 把有效值直接相加了：İ_L 滞后 V̇ 90°、İ_C 超前 V̇ 90°，两者反相，要按相量相加。
10 mA 是电源电流，也等于电阻电流 I_R；题目问的是 L、C 两条支路电流的相量和，不是电源电流。
V̇ 已知，İ_L = V̇/(jω₀L)、İ_C = jω₀CV̇ 的大小和相位都能算出，可以确定。
questions.explain: İ_L = V̇/(jω₀L) = −j100 mA，İ_C = jω₀CV̇ = j100 mA，相加为 0。LC 并联部分对外相当于开路，但内部有 100 mA 的电流在 L、C 之间来回交换能量。所以并联谐振又叫电流谐振。

hints: 并联电路用导纳：Y = G + j(ωC − 1/(ωL))，虚部为零就是谐振。
谐振时 V = I_s/G；支路电流 I_C = ω₀CU，I_L = V/(ω₀L)。
solution: **2. 端电压。** 谐振时 Y = G = 1 mS（最小），V = I_s/G = 10 mA × 1 kΩ = **10 V**，与 I_s 同相。
KCL 检查：İ_R + İ_L + İ_C = 10 − j100 + j100 = 10 mA = İ_s ✓。

en.title: Parallel GCL resonance
statement: A sinusoidal current source İ_s = 10∠0° mA (rms) feeds R = 1 kΩ, L = 10 mH and C = 1 µF in parallel, at the circuit's resonant angular frequency ω₀.
Find the resonant frequency f₀, the terminal voltage V at resonance, the capacitor current I_C, and decide what the phasor sum of the L and C branch currents is.

questions.explain: Parallel resonance: ωC = 1/(ωL), ω₀ = 1/√(LC) = 1/√(10⁻² × 10⁻⁶) = 10⁴ rad/s, f₀ ≈ 1591.5 Hz.

questions.ask: rms terminal voltage at resonance V = ?
questions.explain: At resonance Y = G + j(ωC − 1/ωL) = G: the admittance is minimum and the impedance maximum, equal to R. V = I_s·R = 10 mA × 1 kΩ = 10 V.
I_C = ω₀C·V = 10⁴ × 10⁻⁶ × 10 = 0.1 A = 100 mA, which is Q = R/(ω₀L) = 1000/100 = 10 times the source current.

questions.ask: At resonance, what is the rms value |İ_L + İ_C| of the phasor sum of the L and C branch currents?
choices: 0 (equal in size and opposite in phase; the whole source current flows in R)
choiceExplain: This adds rms values: İ_L lags V̇ by 90° and İ_C leads it by 90°, so they are in antiphase and must be added as phasors.
10 mA is the source current, which equals I_R; the question asks for the phasor sum of the L and C branch currents, not the source current.
V̇ is known, so İ_L = V̇/(jω₀L) and İ_C = jω₀CV̇ are both known in size and phase; it can be determined.
questions.explain: İ_L = V̇/(jω₀L) = −j100 mA and İ_C = jω₀CV̇ = j100 mA add to 0. The parallel L–C pair looks like an open circuit from outside, while 100 mA circulates between L and C, exchanging energy. That is why parallel resonance is also called current resonance.

hints: Use admittance for a parallel circuit: Y = G + j(ωC − 1/(ωL)); resonance is where the imaginary part is zero.
At resonance V = I_s/G; the branch currents are I_C = ω₀CU and I_L = V/(ω₀L).
solution: **1. Resonant frequency.** Im Y = ωC − 1/(ωL) = 0 → ω₀ = 1/√(LC) = **10⁴ rad/s**, f₀ = 10⁴/(2π) ≈ **1591.5 Hz**.
**2. Terminal voltage.** At resonance Y = G = 1 mS (minimum), V = I_s/G = 10 mA × 1 kΩ = **10 V**, in phase with I_s.
**3. Branch currents.** I_R = 10 mA; I_C = ω₀CU = 10⁴ × 10⁻⁶ × 10 = **100 mA** (leading V by 90°); I_L = V/(ω₀L) = 10/100 = 100 mA (lagging V by 90°).
**4. Quality factor.** Q = R/(ω₀L) = ω₀CR = 1000/100 = 10, and I_L = I_C = Q·I_s.
KCL check: İ_R + İ_L + İ_C = 10 − j100 + j100 = 10 mA = İ_s ✓.
